correctness.rationale: The log moment makes the absolute past shot sum well defined: the time integral of min(1,e^(−κs)|Y|) at fixed |Y|=y is y/κ for y≤1 and (1+log y)/κ for y>1. The Brownian convolution exists separately and the linear homogeneous difference decays, giving the stationary law. Independent innovations split the pair as (U,aU+V) with a=e^(−κt) in (0,1). Jumps during (0,t] contribute positive Lévy mass on the vertical axis; the swapped pair has only horizontal and inverse-slope diagonal jump support, hence no such mass off the origin. Lévy uniqueness proves nonexchangeability for each positive t, including D=0 and jumps without ordinary moments. With fourth absolute moment, the common U gives mixed cumulant a^q c_(p+q); c_n=ρE[Y^n]/(nκ) for n=3,4 by time-integrating e^(−nκs). Marginals match; covariance is symmetric, degree-three centered mixed moments are cumulants, and the two degree-four moments have equal three-pairing term 3 Var(Z) Cov(Z_0,Z_t). This verifies signs, the degree threshold from c_3 and c_4>0, and the exact contrasts. Maximizing a(1−a) and a(1−a²) gives the two stated lags; division gives a+a³, strictly increasing on (0,1), so the inversion for κ is exact. Frozen verify.py was inspected, not executed; the recorded 2310 rational assertions are finite checks, not the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Exchangeability of (U,aU+V) and U independent of V imply aU+V independent of U−a(aU+V). In these two linear forms the coefficients of both U and V are nonzero for 0<a<1. Gaussianity would contradict nonzero Lévy measure (even V alone has nonzero compound-Poisson Lévy measure). This mechanical reduction proves the entire frozen moment-free conclusion without relying on the inaccessible reversibility paper.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: At order three the indexed formula with p=1,q=2 is the centered cubic contrast, whose absolute peak follows by differentiating its prescribed lag dependence. No smaller-degree polynomial can distinguish stationary marginals and symmetric covariance; the indexed quartic witness gives degree four if the third cumulant is zero. Its two-lag ratio follows by cancelling the already-known factor 1−a² in 1−a⁴ and multiplying by a; monotonicity is immediate. Neither those deductions nor the moment-free special case constitute a new required exact fact.

value.rationale: A signed thermal-noise-independent witness and its optimal lag are useful, but both are already furnished by the same-model theorem.
